mapper.select: SELECT CS.ID AS COURSE_STUDENT_ID , U.NAME AS STUDENT_NAME , CC.OPINION FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS INNER JOIN "USER" U ON CS.USER_ID = U.ID LEFT JOIN COURSE_CONSULT CC ON CC.COURSE_STUDENT_ID = CS.ID WHERE CS.COURSE_ID = #{_parameter} AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY U.NAME ASC , CS.ID ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS INNER JOIN "USER" U ON CS.USER_ID = U.ID WHERE CS.ID = #{courseStudentId} AND CS.COURSE_ID = #{courseId} AND U.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT CS.ID AS COURSE_STUDENT_ID , C."NO" AS COURSE_NO , C.COURSE_NAME , TO_CHAR(C.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE , TO_CHAR(C.END_DATED, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATE , U.NAME AS STUDENT_NAME , CC.GENDER , CC.CONTACT FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS INNER JOIN COURSE C ON CS.COURSE_ID = C.ID INNER JOIN "USER" U ON CS.USER_ID = U.ID LEFT JOIN COURSE_CONSULT CC ON CC.COURSE_STUDENT_ID = CS.ID WHERE CS.ID = #{_parameter}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COURSE_CONSULT ( COURSE_STUDENT_ID , GENDER , CONTACT ) VALUES ( #{courseStudentId} , #{gender} , #{contact} )
mapper.select: SELECT CC.CAPABILITY_START_LEVEL , CC.CAPABILITY_START_DESC , CC.CAPABILITY_MID_LEVEL , CC.CAPABILITY_MID_DESC , CC.CAPABILITY_END_LEVEL , CC.CAPABILITY_END_DESC FROM COURSE_CONSULT CC WHERE CC.COURSE_STUDENT_ID = #{_parameter}

SELECT TS.ID AS TEST_SET_ID , TS.SET_NAME , TSFC.SCORE FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS INNER JOIN TEST_SCORE_FOR_CHART TSFC ON CS.ID = TSFC.COURSE_STUDENT_ID INNER JOIN TEST_SET TS ON TSFC.TEST_SET_ID = TS.ID WHERE CS.ID = #{_parameter} ORDER BY TS.ID ASC
SELECT ROUND(AVG(TSFC.SCORE), 1) AS AVG_SCORE FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS INNER JOIN TEST_SCORE_FOR_CHART TSFC ON CS.ID = TSFC.COURSE_STUDENT_ID WHERE CS.ID = #{_parameter}

SELECT CCD.ID , TO_CHAR(CCD.CONSULT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CONSULT_DATE , CCD.CONSULT_TYPE , CCD.CONSULT_DESC FROM COURSE_CONSULT_DATA CCD WHERE CCD.COURSE_STUDENT_ID = #{_parameter} ORDER BY CCD.CONSULT_DATE ASC , CCD.ID ASC
mapper.insert:
SELECT 'CC-' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD-') || LPAD(SEQ_COURSE_CONSULT_DATA_PK.NEXTVAL, 6, '0') FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO COURSE_CONSULT_DATA ( ID , CONSULT_DATE , CONSULT_DESC , CONSULT_USER , CONSULT_TYPE , COURSE_STUDENT_ID ) VALUES ( #{id} , SYSDATE , #{consultDesc} , #{consultUser} , #{consultType} , #{courseStudentId} )
